interpretation: generated file lookup (questions generated from top-level JSON fields, named by path words); 0 human-reviewed labels; path-level source-file retrieval, not answer correctness

declaration.declared: committed before the test split was scored; no setting was tuned on either split
declaration.inspected_before_declaring: file sizes, chunk counts per strategy and the questions on which expand_queries returns more than one query, on both splits; no retrieval score on either split
declaration.corpus: every file of the snapshot through app.eval.index_loader.build_index (app.eval.ingest scan_directory and file_chunks), the files that differ from their tracked blob included as they are (the header lists them); a run stops unless every manifest file is indexed and none is rejected
declaration.index: in memory: BM25 (default analyzer, k1 1.5, b 0.75) over each chunk's path context (app.retrieval.context.path_context) and text; the hash embedder (character 3- and 4-grams, 256 dimensions, no model) over the chunk text; RRF k 60; no router, no reranker
declaration.depth: both legs rank every chunk; the fused ranking is cut to its first 50 distinct paths
declaration.metric: nDCG@10 of the path list against the question's one relevant path (primary); MRR@10, Recall@5, Recall@10 and Recall@50 reported
declaration.intervals: dev and test separately; app.eval.robotics.group_bootstrap: whole experiment families resampled with replacement, 2000 resamples, seed 20261007, 95% percentile interval; an arm minus its parent is paired within each resample
declaration.verdict: from the paired interval of the primary metric: above zero, covers zero or below zero; 'identical on every question' when no question's primary score changes; for multiquery, 'rules did not fire' on a split where no rewrite fired

chunking.auto: app.chunking chunk_text strategy auto (structure-aware; the chunker version is recorded with the run)
chunking.fixed: app.chunking fixed_size_chunks for every file: 512 characters, 50 characters of overlap

multiquery.parent: hybrid: the chunking check's auto index
multiquery.rewrite: app.agent.deep_research.multi_query_retrieve, n=3: expand_queries keyword heuristic (no LLM); the fused list of each query RRF-fused again (k 60)
multiquery.fired: a question on which expand_queries returns more than one distinct query (lower case), as the harness counts it

declaration.limits: generated file lookup with no human-reviewed label: a question names its experiment by the words of its path, and the default analyzer keeps '_' inside tokens, so its field words rarely match the file's field names. An interval that covers zero is not evidence that the arms find answers equally well.
